idea-plugin.name: SQL Heading Folding / SQL 标题折叠
idea-plugin.description:
Adds hierarchical comment headings, native code folding, reading-mode labels, and outline navigation to SQL consoles.

Use -- # through -- ##### to organize long SQL scripts in any JetBrains IDE that provides Database Tools and SQL, including IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate and DataGrip.

适用于所有提供 Database Tools and SQL 的 JetBrains IDE（包括 IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate 和 DataGrip），为 SQL 控制台提供分级注释标题、原生代码折叠、阅读态标签与目录导航。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.4

  • Optionally show colored comment nodes in the SQL outline and render them with their configured colors.
  • Keep one trailing blank line visible when a folded section already ends with blank lines.
  • Move to JDK 21 and IntelliJ Platform 2026.2, replacing APIs deprecated by the current platform.
  • Place the colored-node checkbox at the end of the outline toolbar and preserve expanded tree nodes while editing.
  • Add spacing and a tooltip to the colored-node checkbox.
  • Remove Tool Window Factory API verifier warnings caused by generated Kotlin interface bridges.
  • Clarify that the collapse and expand actions control SQL sections in the editor, not the outline tree.
  • Add spacing around the active SQL file name at the top of the outline.

目录可选显示带实际配置颜色的注释节点，并在编辑时保持目录展开状态；折叠区块在原本存在尾部空行时保留一个空行；构建基线升级到 JDK 21 和 IntelliJ Platform 2026.2，并替换当前平台已弃用的 API。
